title: Kirby Air Riders
description: Kirby and a large cast of Riders compete in fast vehicle battles and races. Machines accelerate automatically, while players manage Boost Charge, spins, Specials and Copy Abilities. Modes include Air Ride, Top Ride, City Trial and the single-player Road Trip.

description_short: A fast-paced Kirby vehicle action game combining races, arena battles and City Trial competition with simple controls and deep machine/rider strategy.
description_ar: لعبة سباقات وقتال سريعة من عالم Kirby. اختر الـRider والآلة، استخدم Boost Charge والانجراف والهجمات الخاصة وCopy Abilities، وتنافس في Air Ride وTop Ride وCity Trial إضافة إلى طور Road Trip الفردي.
nintendoPlayModes: TV Mode, Tabletop Mode, Handheld Mode
switch2Features: Online Paddock lobbies for up to 32 players
tagline: Pick your rider, pick your machine, and mount up for fast-paced vehicular action.
fitFor: Players who enjoy arcade racing and arena competition
Players who like easy-to-learn controls with mechanical depth
notFitFor: Players who only want a traditional Kirby platformer

gameplayPillars.title: Simple Two-Button Control
gameplayPillars.description: Machines accelerate automatically while Boost Charge controls braking, drifting and explosive dashes.

gameplayPillars.title: Vehicle Combat
gameplayPillars.description: Quick Spins, rider Specials and Copy Abilities turn races into direct battles.

gameplayPillars.title: City Trial
gameplayPillars.description: Explore Skyah, gather stat-boosting power-ups, swap machines and finish with a Stadium challenge.

gameplayPillars.title: Air Ride and Top Ride
gameplayPillars.description: Race in traditional forward-view courses or compact bird's-eye tracks.

gameplayPillars.title: Road Trip
gameplayPillars.description: A single-player challenge journey that combines the game's racing and battle styles.

storyChapters.title: Road Trip Begins
storyChapters.body: Choose a Rider and take on a sequence of single-player challenges.

storyChapters.title: Story of Zorah
storyChapters.body: Road Trip develops a wild story around Zorah while rotating through the game's different play styles.

storyChapters.title: Master Every Ride
storyChapters.body: Progression encourages trying different Riders, machines, challenges and conditions.

faq.q: Is Kirby Air Riders a traditional kart racer?
faq.a: Not exactly. It combines racing, vehicular combat, arena collection, party-game challenges and a single-player Road Trip.
Up to four on one system, two to eight via local wireless and up to sixteen online depending on mode.
Crowdsourced data lists roughly four hours for the main story, with much more time required for extras and completion.
Yes. Rider-machine dual-pack amiibo can be used as Figure Players that level up through play.
Yes. Kirby Air Riders is a Nintendo Switch 2 exclusive.

verdictSummary: A distinctive, content-rich multiplayer action racer with unusually broad local, wireless and online support and a simple control scheme designed for fast competition.
verdictCons: Competitive structure may feel unusual for players expecting a conventional racer

reviews.quote: Critics generally praised presentation, content volume and mechanical depth.
Strong critic approval with particular praise for its distinctive blend of racing, combat and party-game ideas.
Player aggregate data lists a strong user score.

studioAbout: Kirby Air Riders was directed by Masahiro Sakurai and developed with teams including Sora Ltd. and Bandai Namco Studios for Nintendo. It expands the ideas of Kirby Air Ride into a much larger racing, arena-action and online package.
